transcript.content: Hello, I’m Dr. ____. What brings you in today?

I'm... well, my husband wanted me to come in. I guess... I've been hearing things at work. I'm a mechanic, and... sometimes, when I'm in the garage, I hear this man's voice. It comes from the vents, or sometimes right out from under the hood of a car. It sounds... just like someone is standing right next to me. He keeps telling me... he says I shouldn't trust my husband. And he tells me not to touch certain cars. It's... it's been happening a lot.
Have you used any alcohol, recreational drugs, or new medications recently?
No. I don't... I don't use anything like that. And I haven't taken anything new.
Have you ever lost awareness or had any episodes where you blacked out around the times this happened?
No. I haven't blacked out. I remember everything.
Have you had any periods where your mood was unusually high or irritable for several days?

Yeah... I guess so. Sometimes I get... really sped up. Like I could fix every car in the shop all by myself. I feel like I'm just... flying. But then... if my husband asks about the dishes, or if one of the other techs just touches my tools... I just lose it. I blow up. It feels like they're trying to hold me back or something.
Do the voices or other unusual beliefs happen only when your mood is very high or very irritable?

No... not just then. 

Even when things were a lot quieter for a few weeks... when I was just sleeping more and not making any of those huge plans... I still heard it. That voice in the garage. And... I still knew my husband and my boss were tracking me.
Have you had a period of at least two weeks when you felt depressed or lost interest in things most of the day nearly every day?
I don't really know. I don't... keep track of the days like that. I guess sometimes I'm just tired, but... I wouldn't say I get depressed. Not for weeks at a time.
Before these symptoms started, were you able to work and manage your day-to-day life normally, or has there been a clear decline in how well you functioned?

I guess... things have changed. I... I made some mistakes at the shop. They actually pulled me off the high-voltage EV stuff... said they were worried I wasn't being safe. And... at home... things haven't been great either. We fight a lot. It got bad enough that... well, my husband is the one who brought me in for that emergency evaluation. So... yeah. It's different now.
Have these voices and beliefs been going on continuously for at least six months?
Yeah... I guess so. It's been... maybe ten months? Since I first noticed the voice and... realized they were tracking me.
Have you had a period of at least one week when you felt abnormally energized or ‘up’ most of the day nearly every day?

I guess... yeah. Sometimes. 

I'll get... really going. Like I'm flying high, like I could fix every car in town. Just... non-stop energy. But then... if my husband asks about the dishes, or one of the other techs moves my socket set... I just... I blow up. It feels like they're trying to hold me down. So... yeah, I get like that.
When you get those times of feeling "flying high," how long does one of those periods usually last?
I don't know... a while, I guess. Maybe a week or two? I don't really keep track.
Have you ever had a stretch of at least two weeks when the voices or paranoid beliefs were still there even though your mood felt normal?

Yeah. There was... a time. 

I was... quieter, I guess. Sleeping more. Not... making all those big plans. But... the voice in the garage was still there. And... I still knew my husband and my boss were tracking me. So... yeah. It didn't stop.
Have you ever had a stretch of at least two weeks when you felt depressed or lost interest in things most of the day nearly every day?
I don't think so. Not really. Just... tired sometimes, maybe. But not like that.
Have you ever had a period of at least one week when you felt unusually energized or ‘up’ most of the day nearly every day?

I guess so. Sometimes. When I'm... like that, I'll stay late at the shop. After closing. I'll start a bunch of repair jobs at once. Or... try to plan a car club thing. Reorganize all the parts shelves. I just... I feel like I have to keep moving.
Have there been any times when the voices or the feeling that people were tracking you were present while you were also having a clear manic episode?

Yeah. Um... yes. Even when I was... you know, barely sleeping. Racing around the shop with all those plans. It didn't go away. 

I could still hear the voice coming from the vents. And... I just knew they were using the battery chargers and the security cameras to watch me. So... yeah. Both at the same time.
During those times when you felt ‘flying high,’ did you need much less sleep than usual and still feel rested?

Yeah. Um... I guess so. For weeks at a time, I'd sleep... maybe two or three hours. 

I'd just wake up before dawn. My mind would already be in the garage, so... I just felt like sleeping more would just waste time. I didn't really need it.

During those times when you felt unusually energized or 'up,' did you also ever feel so confident or powerful that you got into risky situations or did things other people thought were out of character for you?

Um... I don't know about risky. I just... I had a lot of ideas. 

I was pretty sure I was the only one who actually understood where the repair business was headed. I figured... if everybody would just listen to me, I could turn our little shop into the top EV place in the state. I guess... maybe the others thought I was acting weird about it. But I just felt like I knew what I was doing.
